crossRefs.note: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his…
Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty…
So they will fear Yahweh’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing…

translations.web: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.
translations.bsb: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.
translations.kjv: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
translations.asv: And the serpent cast out of his mouth after the woman water as a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.
